item.title: Ontario auditors find doctors' AI note takers routinely blow basic facts
item.description:
📝 Twelve of the 20 systems evaluated inserted incorrect drug information into patient notes, while 17 of the systems “missed key details about the patients’ mental health issues” that were discussed in the recordings. Bad evaluations don’t help, eitherAI systems making mistakes isn’t exactly shocking. A good portion of the report blames how the systems were evaluated.
🔗 Read more: https://www.theregister.com/ai-ml/2026/05/14/ontario-auditors-find-doctors-ai-note-takers-routinely-blow-basic-facts/5240771
